title: Sum over padded neighbors
statement: Let $n,D$ be natural numbers, let $r$ be a decidable relation on the set of $n$ indices, and suppose $n\le D$. For any rational-valued function $f$ on those indices and any index $s$, the sum of $f$ over the $D$ padded neighbors of $s$ equals the sum of $f$ over the indices related to $s$, plus $D$ minus the number of such related indices, multiplied by $f(s)$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a decidable relation on the $n$ indices
$f$ maps the $n$ indices to the rationals
